review: Request: at round 26 Kai (health 100, satiety 88.6, energy 40, on forest floor at 13.83, 16.30, 1.06 m from the fallen branches canopy-69 and 0.37 m from forest-dry-grass-0, owning item-24-kai-284, three berries, and having mastered construct-weather-shelter@1, whose round-12 inspection found no suitable named materials) asked to physically examine accessible loose materials or owned samples selected by exact identity and report only properties actually measured (rod length and diameter, usable strand length, mass, moisture, stem characteristics relevant to volume), naming unmeasurable properties and unsuitable samples, consuming or reserving nothing and implying no construction. World Agent decision: develop (learning 2) one general examine-material operation with an exact target, an optional specimen selector, requested properties, mode inspect or measure, and tool or reference ids; one nondestructive round of 0.2 energy per inspect or single-property measure; calibrated length and diameter only with a real graduated tool or a previously calibrated physical reference, otherwise qualitative traits with metric values marked unavailable; mass only with a calibrated balance and real tare; volume only from measured dimensions with a stated geometric method; moisture and rigidity unavailable; the construct-weather-shelter@1 calculation and suitability checks only with genuinely measured inputs and their uncertainty, otherwise undetermined; study 2 rounds at 0.2; invalid requests free. Whether a calibrated reference can exist here: no. The installed mechanisms of this run (the forest, open and expression foundations, prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 and construct-weather-shelter@1) represent no graduated tool, balance or calibrated reference; the ex19 and ex21 lever comparators read only fractions of a reference piece and are scoped to other runs; names and marks have no physical effect; a person's radius (0.22), world coordinates and stock counts are engine conventions the specification forbids as references; and this package never creates, calibrates or repairs a tool. The measurement path is therefore implemented against a declared calibration record and exercised only on test fixtures. What the world represents: the dimensions that construct-weather-shelter@1's free refusal reads come from shelterMeasure: a wood unit is the ex21 rod from its mass (900 kg/m3, 25 diameters; a 1.1 kg branch is 0.03963 x 0.99079 m), a vine or reed unit a version-2 strand (3 or 1.8 m, diameter from its solids at 500 kg/m3; a vine is 0.0113 m thick), reed also a stem whose installed volume follows from solids, density and packing, and dry grass has no stem law; strand strength, water share, flexibility and installed stem volume are record coefficients. Of these a person can observe a separated unit's length and diameter only against a calibrated length reference and its mass only on a calibrated balance; water share, rigidity, strength and installed stem volume are not observable. Implemented (full mechanism, not a first release): examine-material@1 (ability and handler long.examine-material, equivalence measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1, learning 2 at 0.2 energy per study round, 2850 code units, registered last, no visual component, no satisfaction source, no environment hook and no shared runtime change beyond registration). target, resolved by the shared exact-identity resolver, is the person's own item, an unowned item within reach or a material source object within reach with visible stock; specimen is a unit number up to the whole units or visible stock (default 1). Every refusal precedes payment and changes nothing: a missing, unknown, alias or another person's target, reserved material, out of reach, under a hazard, no visible unit, a specimen beyond the units, unresolvable tool ids, too little energy, and for measure anything but exactly one property, moisture or rigidity, no named tool with a valid record for the quantity, a unit in place, a partial or worked unit, a material without a represented dimension, volume without current length and diameter readings or without method cylinder, and darkness for tool readings; each refusal lists all its reasons and, for a missing reference or balance, the unmet requirement. inspect handles and looks at one unit: form, hand feel of elongated pieces, wholeness and setting always; colour, visible dryness, damage from the ex19 contact model, worked or treated records and visible wear only in light, otherwise 'not seen: too dark'; for a source also the probe-observe visible state (stock, growth, stage, soil); every requested metric property is reported unavailable with its reasons, for Kai now 'metric dimensions unavailable: no calibrated reference'. measure reads one property with a tool that is a carried or reachable item (processing.measurementCalibration) or a reachable object (data.measurementCalibration) whose record is complete and verified (form graduated-scale or reference-length for length in m, or balance for mass in kg; resolution, uncertainty, range, verified true, standard, method, evidence, calibratedAt not after now, the calibrating revision, condition at least 0.75, and a tare for a balance); the value is the represented dimension or unit mass rounded to the resolution, its uncertainty is placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), placements being the length over the range rounded up, plus 1% of the reading for a pliable strand laid out by hand; a value below the resolution or a diameter or load beyond the range is a paid limit with no value (material-examination-limited); volume with method cylinder derives pi/4 x d^2 x L with relative uncertainty 2 u_d/d + u_L/L from the person's current length and diameter readings of the same unit, as an envelope volume only. Records: every paid round keeps a record (identity, round, target, specimen, setting, resource, origin, a digest of the unit record, property, status, value, unit, uncertainty, resolution, placements, method, tool and calibration provenance, basis, limitation, one round and 0.2 energy, evidence id) in a bounded personal log of 16 and an unverified personal record through openRemember; a reading is current only while the unit-record digest is unchanged, so later weather, decay or deformation makes it stale and volume refuses it. Shelter comparison: every result cites construct-weather-shelter@1 and judges the rod checks over both ends of the reading's uncertainty (diameter at least 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; length at least 0.82111026 m for a leg and 0.9 m for a ridge, rail or batten: meets, fails or indeterminate), reports a measured strand length toward the 30 m binding minimum, and lists the unmeasurable inputs (rod rigidity; wrapping pliability and strand strength; for reed and dry grass the water share and installed volume, and the missing dry-grass stem law); the verdict is fails with the failed checks or undetermined, never suitable, and covers only that unit. Events: material-examination-handled at the start of each paid round (a handling overlay within reach; a tool and instrument form only when physically present), then the trial-result record and material-examination-inspected, -measured or -limited, all with view metadata (operation, mode, actor, target, specimen, setting, property, status handling, qualitative, measured or limited, progress, rounds, position, tool, instrument, value, units, uncertainty, evidence, a label showing only a measured value, 'qualitative traits only' or 'unavailable', the unavailable properties and the shelter verdict); nothing is consumed, reserved, moved or changed, and no stock, object or shelter state changes. Each examination is atomic and commits when its round completes, so no partial work, pause, resume, cancel or death handling exists and nothing is refunded. No reward: the review's proposed information-gain contribution was not implemented because this handoff excludes rewards; every record is unverified, no event carries a qualified flag and the practice evidence event never qualifies. Reuse: shelterMeasure, shelterMinLength and WEATHER_SHELTER of the construct-weather-shelter@1 physics; openRemember and the probe-observe visible-state value of foundation-open@1 (mirrored, not called); forestResolveReference for target and tools; ex19MaterialContact, ex19MaterialDark and ex19MaterialWhole; SMALL_FIRE.rigid of small-combustion-source@1; openConditions and forestClimate. No existing package changed: the test asserts one digest over all 120 previously registered packages (validation-results/scratch/ex24/hashes-before-3.json, taken before this change) and the individual hashes of foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, small-combustion-source@1, cutting-edge-assessment@1, prepare-ventilated-food-storage@1 and construct-weather-shelter@1. What Kai can do now: study for 2 rounds (0.4 energy), then for 0.2 energy a round inspect one unit of canopy-69 in place, forest-dry-grass-0 or an owned or dropped unit and learn its qualitative traits, that metric dimensions are unavailable without a calibrated reference and that shelter suitability is undetermined; every measure is refused at no cost with the unmet requirement (a real graduated tool or a previously calibrated physical reference, or a calibrated balance with a tare), which nothing in this run provides. A throwaway check on the archived round-26 world (since deleted) installed the package: Kai mastered it at round 28, inspected canopy-69 in place (elongated wood piece, stiff, looks moist; metric dimensions unavailable: no calibrated reference; undetermined), forest-dry-grass-0 (fine thin stems, pliable, looks dry; no represented length or diameter) and the owned berries (recipe suitability not applicable), 0.2 energy each, and a length measure of canopy-69 was refused at no cost. Assumptions: (1) a unit in a source pile or on a plant is examined in place: it is seen and felt, but it cannot be laid against a reference without separating it, which is gathering, so every metric reading needs a carried or loose unit; (2) the units of one stack or source share one record, so the specimen number labels the handled unit but cannot distinguish different properties, and each record covers that unit only; (3) the represented dimensions are shelterMeasure's ex21 rod law for wood and version-2 strand law for vine and reed, the mass of a whole plain unit is its represented unit mass, and partial units and worked or treated items have no represented geometry or mass reading; (4) a calibrated tool is any item or object carrying a complete, verified measurementCalibration record, trusted as declared provenance because only reviewed package code writes item records, and a condition below 0.75 (the shelter's sound threshold) is not serviceable; (5) readings round the represented value to the tool resolution, uncertainty adds the calibration uncertainty and half a graduation for each placement along the range (a conservative linear sum), and a pliable strand (flexibility at least 5) laid out straight by hand adds 1% of its reading; (6) a value below the resolution and a diameter or load beyond the range are found only while reading, so they are charged as a paid limit with no value; (7) tool readings need the light at which the ex19 checks see surfaces (above 0.1), while inspection is by handling and is paid in the dark with the visual traits unreported; (8) visible dryness bands of the represented water share are dry up to 0.4 (the shelter's and the world's air-dry grass), moist below 0.8 and wet from 0.8, and hand feel, for elongated pieces only, is stiff up to flexibility 3 (the ex21 rigidity limit), bends a little at 4 and pliable from 5 (the ex16 wrap limit); neither is reported as a number or used as a measurement; (9) the rod checks judge both ends of the uncertainty interval, a check failing at both ends is a measured failure, and rigidity, water share, pliability and strength stay unmeasurable, so the verdict is never suitable; (10) volume is an envelope cylinder with linear relative uncertainty, not a packed covering or bedding volume, and is not compared with the recipe's installed volumes; (11) a reading is current while the digest of the unit record (resource, origin, harvest time, quantity, composition, processing, decay, part condition and contact state, not position) is unchanged; (12) a hazard at a loose item or source makes it not safely accessible, and another person's carried items are not visible to the resolver. Narrowed: the construct-weather-shelter@1 test now checks that its package is the second ex24 package and that the scope's first two packages are the rack and the shelter, instead of registered last and alone. Checks: pnpm typecheck, eslint with no warnings and prettier on the four changed files, this test (6 tests), the two long-run scenario tests and every test of experiments 19 to 24 (21 files, 215 tests) passed.
